panels.description: Overall CPU usage percentage over time

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time AS time,
  cpu_usage AS `CPU Usage %`
FROM
  `3cx_call_data.tsdb_system`
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time
;

panels.title: CPU-Auslastung (Verlauf)

panels.description: Memory usage (used vs total) over time

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time AS time,
  total_phys_mem AS `Total Memory`,
  (total_phys_mem - free_phys_mem) AS `Used Memory`,
  free_phys_mem AS `Free Memory`
FROM
  `3cx_call_data.tsdb_system`
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time
;

panels.title: Speicherauslastung (Verlauf)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  cpu_usage AS `CPU Usage %`
FROM
  `3cx_call_data.tsdb_system`
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY
  time DESC
LIMIT 1
;

SELECT
  ROUND(((CAST(total_phys_mem - free_phys_mem AS NUMERIC)) / total_phys_mem) * 100, 2) AS `Memory Usage %`
FROM
  `3cx_call_data.tsdb_system`
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY
  time DESC
LIMIT 1
;

SELECT
  ROUND(((CAST(total_disk_space - free_disk_space AS NUMERIC)) / total_disk_space) * 100, 2) AS `Disk Usage %`
FROM
  `3cx_call_data.tsdb_system`
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY
  time DESC
LIMIT 1
;

panels.description: Most active service by memory usage

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  service AS Service_ID,
  ROUND(private_memory / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS Memory_MB
FROM
  `3cx_call_data.tsdb_services`
WHERE
  time = (
    SELECT MAX(time)
    FROM `3cx_call_data.tsdb_services`
    WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  )
ORDER BY
  private_memory DESC
LIMIT 1
;

panels.title: Aktivster Dienst

panels.description: Disk space usage trends over time

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time AS time,
  (total_disk_space - free_disk_space) AS Used_Disk_Space,
  free_disk_space AS Free_Disk_Space
FROM
  `3cx_call_data.tsdb_system`
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY
  time ASC
;

panels.title: Festplattentrend

panels.description: Network traffic in and out (calculated from deltas)

targets.rawSql:
WITH network_deltas AS (
  SELECT
    time,
    id,
    bytes_sent - LAG(bytes_sent) OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY time) AS bytes_sent_delta,
    bytes_received - LAG(bytes_received) OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY time) AS bytes_received_delta,
    TIMESTAMP_DIFF(time, LAG(time) OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY time), SECOND) AS time_diff
  FROM
    `3cx_call_data.tsdb_network`
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(time)
)
SELECT
  time AS time,
  CASE
    WHEN time_diff > 0 THEN bytes_received_delta / time_diff
    ELSE 0
  END AS Network_In,
  CASE
    WHEN time_diff > 0 THEN bytes_sent_delta / time_diff
    ELSE 0
  END AS Network_Out
FROM
  network_deltas
WHERE
  bytes_sent_delta IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  time ASC
;

panels.description: Speicherverbrauch der einzelnen 3CX-Dienste über die Zeit

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time,
  CASE
    WHEN service = 0 THEN 'Database'
    WHEN service = 1 THEN 'Configuration'
    WHEN service = 2 THEN 'AudioProvider'
    WHEN service = 3 THEN 'SIPService'
    WHEN service = 4 THEN 'SystemService'
    WHEN service = 5 THEN 'IVR'
    WHEN service = 6 THEN 'CallFlow'
    WHEN service = 7 THEN 'QueueMananger'
    WHEN service = 8 THEN 'Tunnel'
    WHEN service = 9 THEN 'ManagementConsole'
    WHEN service = 10 THEN 'MediaServer'
    WHEN service = 11 THEN 'HotelModule'
    WHEN service = 12 THEN 'EventNotiificationManager'
    WHEN service = 13 THEN 'Nginx'
    WHEN service = 14 THEN 'Gateway'
  END AS service,
  private_memory AS Memory
FROM
  `3cx_call_data.tsdb_services`
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  -- AND service IN UNNEST(
  --   ARRAY(
  --     SELECT CAST(x AS INT64)
  --     FROM UNNEST(SPLIT('${service_filter}', ',')) AS x
  --   )
  -- )
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- Can be used with non-multiselection approach with 'All' item value = -1
  --AND ('${service_filter_test:value}' = '-1' OR service = SAFE_CAST('${service_filter:value}' AS INT64))
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- Can be used with multiselection approach
  AND service IN (${service_filter:csv})
ORDER BY time
;

panels.title: Dienst-Speicherverbrauch

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CAST(s.service AS string) || '_service' AS service,
  s.thread_count AS Thread_Count
FROM
  `3cx_call_data.tsdb_services` AS s
WHERE
  time = (
    SELECT MAX(time)
    FROM `3cx_call_data.tsdb_services`
    WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  )
  --AND CAST(service AS STRING) IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${service_filter}', ','))
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- Can be used with non-multiselection approach with 'All' item value = -1
  --AND ('${service_filter_test:value}' = '-1' OR service = SAFE_CAST('${service_filter:value}' AS INT64))
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- Can be used with multiselection approach
  AND s.service IN (${service_filter:csv})
ORDER BY
  service ASC
;

panels.description: Detailed service metrics over time for selected service

targets.rawSql:
WITH times AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    s.time
  FROM `3cx_call_data.tsdb_services` AS s
  WHERE $__timeFilter(s.time)
)
SELECT
  s.time AS time,
  SUM(s.private_memory) AS memory_usage,
  SUM(s.thread_count) AS thread_count,
  SUM(s.handle_count) AS handle_count,
  SUM(s.process_count) AS process_count
FROM
  `3cx_call_data.tsdb_services` AS s
  INNER JOIN times AS t ON
    t.time = s.time
WHERE
  --$__timeFilter(time)
  --AND CAST(service AS STRING) IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${service_filter}', ','))
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- Can be used with non-multiselection approach with 'All' item value = -1
  --AND ('${service_filter_test:value}' = '-1' OR service = SAFE_CAST('${service_filter:value}' AS INT64))
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- Can be used with multiselection approach
  s.service IN (${service_filter:csv})
GROUP BY s.time
ORDER BY s.time
;
